description: Compress unsupported frontier cases with low-orbit templates only if exact witnesses exhibit symmetry signals. This keeps the symmetry lane evidence-driven instead of aesthetic.

implementation_hypothesis: Mine exact witnesses for orbit size patterns before spending any frontier budget on composite-order templates.
experiment_seed: Estimate automorphism proxies and degree-repeat signatures for exact witnesses through n=22.
